title: Section 173 BNSS — Information in cognizable cases

content.heading: Information in cognizable cases
content.text: Section 173 BNSS is the current provision for information relating to cognizable offences. Read the official notified text on India Code. Do not treat it as a word-for-word reprint of CrPC section 154. Pending investigations may still be governed by CrPC under BNSS section 531.
